faq.headline: The honest answers.
faq.intro: Five things people usually want to know before they put a call on the calendar.

items.question: What actually happens on the call?
items.answer: Thirty minutes over video. We pull up your live site, you tell us what's not working, and we give you a straight read on what we'd change and why. You walk away with something useful: a clear next step, whether or not we work together.

items.question: Is this a sales pitch?
items.answer: No. It's a working session, not a pitch. If we're not the right team for what you need, we'll say so, and usually point you somewhere better. We'd rather pass than take on work we can't make great.

items.question: Who will I be talking to?
items.answer: One of the people who'd actually run your project, often Arnel, the founder. Never a salesperson or an account manager reading off a script. The people on the call are the people on the work.

items.question: What if I'm not ready to commit?
items.answer: Then don't. Book it as a second opinion. Plenty of the calls we take are with teams just pressure-testing an idea or a redesign. No obligation, and no follow-up sequence chasing you afterward.

items.question: How much does it cost to work together?
items.answer: Engagements start from $5k/mo, custom-scoped to your goals, cancel anytime. We confirm the exact scope on the call so you know precisely what that buys before anything starts.
